The '''1936–37 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the eighth season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The champions of the 3 founding Associations of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] participated in the championship, which were the [[Athens Football Clubs Association|Αthenian]], the [[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus']] and the [[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian]] association. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won the championship, for the fifth time in its history and for the first time undefeated. The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point'' - ''Loss: 0 points''.
